funding_summary: The project has received a net EU financial contribution of €145,000.
inflection_why_now: The increasing demand for high-resolution neural data in neuroscience and medical applications necessitates efficient data compression solutions, making AIM-HIGH's technology timely and relevant.
devils_advocate_risks: Technical Risk: Ensuring the scalability and reliability of the SODA technology in real-world, freely moving animal models may present challenges.
Market Risk: Achieving product-market fit and widespread adoption of the new telemetry system within the neuroscience and medical research communities could be challenging.

Their focus on breakthrough innovations in health and agriculture could complement AIM-HIGH's advancements in neuroscience and medical technology.
